title: Are you sure you know what 'gaslighting' is?
summary: Therapists say we're overusing the word. Here's what it actually means — and what the Ingrid Bergman film that helped birth the word can teach us about it.
contentText:
Gaslight starring Ingrid Bergman and Charles Boyer dramatizes the concept of gaslighting.'/> Therapists say we're overusing the word. Here's what it actually means — and what the Ingrid Bergman film that helped birth the word can teach us about it.
